query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS training_batch_comments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  batchId VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  userName VARCHAR(255),
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  parentId INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_batch_comment_batch (batchId),
  INDEX idx_batch_comment_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_batch_comment_parent (parentId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS training_batch_tags (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  color VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '#3b82f6' NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_batch_tag_name (name)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS training_batch_tag_assignments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  batchId VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  tagId INT NOT NULL,
  assignedBy INT NOT NULL,
  assignedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_batch_tag_assign_batch (batchId),
  INDEX idx_batch_tag_assign_tag (tagId)
);
